title: Ohio River Launch Club
specs: Oldest boat club on the Ohio River, established 1898
2,500 feet of dock and fifty boats at the same bend in the river since 1898
No boat ownership required for social membership
includes: Electric and water at the slip
Restrooms, showers, grills, ice, parking for 60-plus cars
High-water rigging handled by the harbor crew
blurb: Guests can rent seasonal boat slips with electric and water, store kayaks or paddleboards with dedicated launch access, or use transient dockage for overnight stays. The club has floating docks rigged for high water and offers full harbor facilities including restrooms, showers, grills, and parking. Memberships are available for boat owners, social members without boats, and kayak users, with no waiting list usually.
extraNote: Boat slip members buy $600 in ownership notes refundable when leaving · Transient dockage $35 a night, $150 a week, $400 a month; holiday rate $50 a night on July 3-4 and Labor Day weekend · Docks float and crew handles rigging during high water · Ohio River mile marker 466 on the Cincinnati side, at 100 Strader Ave in the historic East End
